definition: TODAY TB RETURN % = (realized TB-owned PnL for current broker/server account day + current unrealized TB-owned PnL) / start-of-day account equity
ownership: TB magic (31082026/31082027) + comment tag 'TB|' + ledger linkage ONLY; manual trades / foreign EAs / other strategies excluded
daily_boundary: broker/server account day; this broker server clock = UTC+3, so the day rolls at 00:00 server = 21:00 UTC (documented in runtime status; derived from the live calibrated offset at runtime, not hardcoded)

implementation.worker: _server_day() computes (server-day key, UTC epoch of server midnight) from the calibrated offset; _pnl() filters owned deals by that epoch and divides by the frozen daily NAV
implementation.dashboard: TODAY TB PNL $ and TODAY TB RETURN % rendered from the heartbeat (schema v2)
implementation.heartbeat_schema: added today_pnl_pct with ALTER TABLE migration for older DBs

unit_tests.name: server midnight in UTC = 21:00 prev-day UTC (UTC+3)
today PnL uses server-day boundary (pre-midnight deal excluded)
